pr_title: drivers: i2c: esp32: fix timing and stop bit
pr_body:
Current implementation fails due to missing stop bit
when reading data. This fixes it and refactor the implementation
by adding k_busy_wait when waiting I2C bus completion.

Also, this implementation is based on esp-idf v3.0.
It will be refactored based on latest esp-idf v4.3 using proper
low level calls.

Signed-off-by: Sylvio Alves <sylvio.alves@espressif.com>

Fixes #34015

review_comments: Why is it busy wait instead of k_sleep?
Using `k_sleep(K_USEC(1))` increases latency from 10us to 100us between byte read call. This timeout is not for the whole transfer, only to wait I2C channel to become idle.

So where does 1ms (`#define I2C_ESP32_TIMEOUT_USEC  1000`) timeout come from?

>This timeout is not for the whole transfer, only to wait I2C channel to become idle.

Become idle from which state?

>Using k_sleep(K_USEC(1)) increases latency from 10us ....

10us, not 1us? Won't that 1ms timeout become 10ms then?

@mniestroj , this 1ms wait time comes from esp-idf 3.0 I2C implementation, where it checks I2C bus line errors (or busy).  
Regarding the `k_sleep`, it works based on system tick, which would not be small as ~1us (which we do have with nop operations or `k_busy_wait()`).
